summary: Rebuilds the Plugin Manager toolchain with patched Go components and permits protected package publication to reuse only content-identical immutable dependencies.
userImpact: Plugin installer and manager images contain a patched ORAS build and the current Cosign patch release.
A manager-only or installer-only package update no longer requires artificial version bumps for unchanged SDK and runtime packages.

instructions: Use plugin installer 0.2.1, Plugin Manager 0.1.1, and the matching 0.2.1 and 0.1.1 Helm charts; do not consume artifacts from the aborted 0.2.0/0.1.0 toolchain publication run.

security: ORAS 1.3.3 is compiled with the digest-pinned Go 1.26.6 toolchain instead of redistributing its vulnerable upstream binary.
Cosign 3.1.3 is compiled with patched Go 1.26.6 plus the fixed x/mod and x/text dependency floors instead of redistributing the vulnerable upstream binary.

Existing npm package versions may be reused only when a freshly downloaded registry archive has the same canonical file tree, content, symlink targets, and executable bits as the local package; version collisions with different payloads fail closed.
Pull requests that change the public installer or manager now build both images and fail on HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerabilities before protected publication.
documentation: Container third-party notices record the patched ORAS build and Cosign version for both public toolchain images.
knownLimitations: The aborted toolchain publication subjects remain unqualified and are not referenced by a release receipt or supported catalog entry.
rollback: Restore the previous image and chart references only in an isolated test environment; the previous publication failed the protected vulnerability gate and is not supported.
validation: Plugin package publication planner unit tests and protected registry-integrity checks
Multi-architecture installer and manager builds with architecture-neutral JavaScript dependency enforcement
Protected Cosign verification, Trivy HIGH/CRITICAL gate, Helm payload verification, provenance attestations, and offline Zot import acceptance
